title: Written Warning And Reprimand In Mallworld.
content: So, I have a job in the hospital in Mallworld, last night I was given a Warning and a reprimand. Too many trips to the bathroom, and a 2 minute limit. Bwahahaha. I was also glared at for trying to find out why the computer system had been changed and told "it doesn't concern you". What a night. See y'all at The Mall.
